title: OL-20261118-4: Q-TENANT-trust-pk-rebuild: widen trust_ledger primary key to include tenant_id
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** first second tenant sharing a runtime database
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/migrations/0027_trust_ledger_tenant_pk.sql::tenant_id
**Status:** open

0026 adds tenant_id additively, but trust_ledger keeps PRIMARY KEY (surface, action_class); a foreign-tenant row at the same key blocks own trust accrual. Rebuild the table (export to R2 first) with a (tenant_id, surface, action_class) key.
